+package server
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+
+	qrcode "github.com/skip2/go-qrcode"
+)
+
+// qrPNGSize is the side of the square PNG the endpoint answers, in pixels.
+const qrPNGSize = 256
+
+// shortURL is the link's own address: the scheme and host the request came in
+// on, with the slug under /. X-Forwarded-Proto names the scheme the client
+// sees behind a proxy, as in firstForwardedProto; the Host header is what the
+// browser asked for.
+func shortURL(r *http.Request, slug string) string {
+	scheme := "http"
+	if p := firstForwardedProto(r); p != "" {
+		scheme = p
+	} else if r.TLS != nil {
+		scheme = "https"
+	}
+	host := r.Host
+	if host == "" {
+		host = r.URL.Host
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(scheme)
+	b.WriteString("://")
+	b.WriteString(host)
+	b.WriteByte('/')
+	b.WriteString(slug)
+	return b.String()
+}
+
+// init registers GET /api/links/{slug}/qr, which answers the short URL of one
+// of the user's own links as a PNG.
+func init() {
+	addRoutes(func(s *Server) {
+		s.HandleFunc("GET /api/links/{slug}/qr", s.qrCode)
+	})
+}
+
+// qrCode is GET /api/links/<slug>/qr: a login is required, and a link the user
+// does not own answers 404 like an unknown one.
+func (s *Server) qrCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	userID, ok := requireUser(w, r)
+	if !ok {
+		return
+	}
+	slug := r.PathValue("slug")
+	link, err := s.store.GetLinkBySlug(r.Context(), slug)
+	if errors.Is(err, storeErrNotFound) {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	if link.UserID != userID {
+		// Another user's link is no different from one that is not there.
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	png, err := qrcode.Encode(shortURL(r, link.Slug), qrcode.Medium, qrPNGSize)
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/png")
+	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	_, _ = w.Write(png)
+}

+// qrPNGSize is the side of the square PNG the endpoint answers, in pixels.
+const qrPNGSize = 256
+
+// shortURL is the link's own address: the scheme and host the request came in
+// on, with the slug under /. X-Forwarded-Proto names the scheme the client
+// sees behind a proxy, as in firstForwardedProto; the Host header is what the
+// browser asked for.
+func shortURL(r *http.Request, slug string) string {
+	scheme := "http"
+	if p := firstForwardedProto(r); p != "" {
+		scheme = p
+	} else if r.TLS != nil {
+		scheme = "https"
+	}
+	host := r.Host
+	if host == "" {
+		host = r.URL.Host
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(scheme)
+	b.WriteString("://")
+	b.WriteString(host)
+	b.WriteByte('/')
+	b.WriteString(slug)
+	return b.String()
+}
+
+// init registers GET /api/links/{slug}/qr, which answers the short URL of one
+// of the user's own links as a PNG.
+func init() {
+	addRoutes(func(s *Server) {
+		s.HandleFunc("GET /api/links/{slug}/qr", s.qrCode)
+	})
+}
+
+// qrCode is GET /api/links/<slug>/qr: a login is required, and a link the user
+// does not own answers 404 like an unknown one.
+func (s *Server) qrCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	userID, ok := requireUser(w, r)
+	if !ok {
+		return
+	}
+	slug := r.PathValue("slug")
+	link, err := s.store.GetLinkBySlug(r.Context(), slug)
+	if errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	if link.UserID != userID {
+		// Another user's link is no different from one that is not there.
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	png, err := qrcode.Encode(shortURL(r, link.Slug), qrcode.Medium, qrPNGSize)
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/png")
+	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	_, _ = w.Write(png)
+}

+package server

+// qrPNGSize is the side of the square PNG the endpoint answers, in pixels.
+const qrPNGSize = 256
+
+// shortURL is the link's own address: the scheme and host the request came in
+// on, with the slug under /. X-Forwarded-Proto names the scheme the client
+// sees behind a proxy, as in firstForwardedProto; the Host header is what the
+// browser asked for.
+func shortURL(r *http.Request, slug string) string {
+	scheme := "http"
+	if p := firstForwardedProto(r); p != "" {
+		scheme = p
+	} else if r.TLS != nil {
+		scheme = "https"
+	}
+	host := r.Host
+	if host == "" {
+		host = r.URL.Host
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(scheme)
+	b.WriteString("://")
+	b.WriteString(host)
+	b.WriteByte('/')
+	b.WriteString(slug)
+	return b.String()
+}
+
+// init registers GET /api/links/{slug}/qr, which answers the short URL of one
+// of the user's own links as a PNG.
+func init() {
+	addRoutes(func(s *Server) {
+		s.HandleFunc("GET /api/links/{slug}/qr", s.qrCode)
+	})
+}
+
+// qrCode is GET /api/links/<slug>/qr: a login is required, and a link the user
+// does not own answers 404 like an unknown one.
+func (s *Server) qrCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	userID, ok := requireUser(w, r)
+	if !ok {
+		return
+	}
+	slug := r.PathValue("slug")
+	link, err := s.store.GetLinkBySlug(r.Context(), slug)
+	if errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	if link.UserID != userID {
+		// Another user's link is no different from one that is not there.
+		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+	// Medium keeps the grid small enough to read off a screen while a URL of
+	// the spec's 2048 characters still fits its largest version.
+	png, err := qrcode.Encode(shortURL(r, link.Slug), qrcode.Medium, qrPNGSize)
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/png")
+	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	_, _ = w.Write(png)
+}
